title: Chapter 1
description:
Survival

33 years old. 2026.

This year, making it to next month comes before making money.
Five hundred thousand won in the bank. One room left after Father's debt was paid.

Seoul will not wait.
He starts anyway.

title: Chapter 2
description:
Expansion

34 years old. 2027.

More doors open. Profit and danger both grow when people carry them.
A year ago, he did not know that money calls money and people make opportunity.

Now he does.
He still does not know which doors to close.

title: Chapter 3
description:
Truth

35 years old. 2028.

Names he never knew begin to connect.
Once he knows, he cannot choose as if he did not.

The numbers remain the same. The hands that passed them along come into view.
Even looking away takes effort this year.

title: Chapter 4
description:
Weight

36 years old. 2029.

Accumulated choices return as weight in his body and his relationships.
What he dropped and what he held now have the shape of a life.

The calendar folds faster than before.
None of those choices were light.

title: Chapter 5
description:
Reckoning

37 years old. 2030.

Time now runs down in weeks, not months.
The hand he holds and the promises he postponed come due together.

This is the final year.
The number he reached and the people who remain enter the same ledger.
